title: MISSIONARY VOLUNTEERS
stanzas: Missionary volunteers stand for service true and it means the Gospel message all the wide world through.
Let us work till Jesus comes without doubt or fear, That we may hear the "Well done my faithful volunteers."
chorus: Volunteers, volunteers, How I love the name, volunteers, volunteers, Jesus to proclaim, Faithfully we'll work each day and thro' coming years. M means we're missionaries, V means volunteers.
